description.en: MiniMax-H3 text-to-audio/video generation through the official T2VA pipeline: Qwen3-VL text conditioning, joint audio/video DiT denoising, and MiniMax-H3 audio/video VAE decode.
description.zh: MiniMax-H3 通过官方 T2VA 管线实现文本转音频/视频：Qwen3-VL 文本条件、音视频联合 DiT 去噪与 MiniMax-H3 音视频 VAE 解码。

num_inference_steps.en: Positive joint DiT denoising step count; default 50.

seed.en: Unsigned 32-bit generation seed in [0, 4294967295] for deterministic initial latents; default 42.
seed.zh: [0, 4294967295] 中的无符号 32 位生成种子，用于确定性初始潜伏；默认 42。

height.en: Target video canvas height used by the joint T2VA latent layout; omitted or nonpositive values use 768. Smaller positive sizes are rounded up to the supported geometry.
height.zh: 联合 T2VA 潜在布局使用的目标视频画布高度；省略或非正值使用 768。较小的正值将向上舍入到支持的几何形状。

width.en: Target video canvas width used by the joint T2VA latent layout; omitted or nonpositive values use 1344. Smaller positive sizes are rounded up to the supported geometry.
width.zh: 联合 T2VA 潜在布局使用的目标视频画布宽度；省略或非正值使用 1344。较小的正值将向上舍入到支持的几何形状。

num_frames.en: Target video frame count before H3 alignment; omitted or nonpositive values use 124. MiniMax-H3 video is 24 fps; positive counts are rounded to the supported temporal geometry.
num_frames.zh: H3对齐前的目标视频帧数；省略或非正值使用 124。MiniMax-H3 视频为 24 fps；正计数四舍五入到支持的时间几何。

guidance_scale.en: Classifier-free guidance scale; 1.0 matches the baseline T2VA audio run.
guidance_scale.zh: 无分类器引导强度；1.0 与基线 T2VA 音频运行一致。

negative_prompt.en: Negative prompt used by classifier-free guidance when guidance_scale is not 1.0.
negative_prompt.zh: guidance_scale 不为 1.0 时，无分类器引导使用的负向提示。

flow_shift.zh: 视频 FlowMatch 调度器的 shift。

audio_flow_shift.zh: 音频 FlowMatch 调度器的 shift。

return_video.en: Decode and return RGB24 video frames as an output artifact.
return_video.zh: 解码并以 RGB24 视频帧输出。

sampler_mode.en: Joint DiT sampler: euler, res_multistep, dpmpp_2m, or unipc.
sampler_mode.zh: 联合 DiT 采样器：euler、res_multistep、dpmpp_2m 或 unipc。

text_layerwise.en: Run the prompt encoder with scoped layer-group weights instead of a full prompt encoder weight store.
text_layerwise.zh: 使用作用域层组权重的提示编码器，而不是完整提示编码器权重存储。

text_layerwise_batch.en: Prompt encoder layer-group size when text_layerwise is enabled.
text_layerwise_batch.zh: 启用 text_layerwise 时的提示编码器层组大小。

dit_layerwise.en: Run the DiT denoiser with scoped prelude, block-group, and final weights instead of a full DiT weight store.
dit_layerwise.zh: 使用作用域 prelude、块组与最终权重的 DiT 去噪器，而不是完整 DiT 权重存储。

dit_layerwise_batch.en: DiT block-group size when dit_layerwise is enabled.
dit_layerwise_batch.zh: 启用 dit_layerwise 时的 DiT 块组大小。

dit_mlp_chunk_tokens.en: Token chunk size for the per-token DiT MLP in layerwise high-resolution mode. Zero disables chunking.
dit_mlp_chunk_tokens.zh: 分层高分辨率模式下逐 token DiT MLP 的 token 分块大小；0 关闭分块。

dit_acceleration.en: Optional DiT acceleration mode: none, first_block_cache, or spectrum. Requires dit_layerwise=false and sampler_mode=euler; Spectrum additionally requires guidance_scale=1.
dit_acceleration.zh: 可选的 DiT 加速模式：none、first_block_cache 或 spectrum。要求 dit_layerwise=false 且 sampler_mode=euler；Spectrum 还要求 guidance_scale=1。

first_block_cache_threshold.zh: 首块缓存残差差值阈值。

first_block_cache_start_percent.en: Denoising progress fraction where first-block caching begins; must be below end_percent. Used to derive the sigma window when explicit sigma endpoints are omitted.
first_block_cache_start_percent.zh: 首块缓存开始的去噪进度比例；必须小于 end_percent。省略显式 sigma 端点时用于推导 sigma 窗口。

first_block_cache_end_percent.en: Denoising progress fraction where first-block caching ends; must exceed start_percent. Used to derive the sigma window when explicit sigma endpoints are omitted.
first_block_cache_end_percent.zh: 首块缓存结束的去噪进度比例；必须大于 start_percent。省略显式 sigma 端点时用于推导 sigma 窗口。

first_block_cache_start_sigma.en: Largest video sigma where first-block cache may be used. Supply together with first_block_cache_end_sigma; otherwise both endpoints are derived from the denoising progress fractions and schedule.
first_block_cache_start_sigma.zh: 可使用首块缓存的最大视频 sigma。需与 first_block_cache_end_sigma 一起提供；否则两个端点由去噪进度比例与调度推导。

first_block_cache_end_sigma.en: Smallest video sigma where first-block cache may be used. Supply together with first_block_cache_start_sigma; otherwise both endpoints are derived from the denoising progress fractions and schedule.
first_block_cache_end_sigma.zh: 可使用首块缓存的最小视频 sigma。需与 first_block_cache_start_sigma 一起提供；否则两个端点由去噪进度比例与调度推导。

first_block_cache_max_consecutive.en: Maximum consecutive first-block cache hits before forcing a full DiT step.
first_block_cache_max_consecutive.zh: 强制完整 DiT 步前允许的最大连续首块缓存命中次数。

spectrum_warmup_steps.en: Full DiT warmup steps before spectrum forecasting may skip steps.
spectrum_warmup_steps.zh: spectrum 预测开始跳步前的完整 DiT 预热步数。

spectrum_initial_window.zh: 初始 spectrum 预测调度窗口。

spectrum_flex_window.en: Spectrum forecast window growth after actual DiT steps.
spectrum_flex_window.zh: 实际 DiT 步后 spectrum 预测窗口增长量。

spectrum_degree.en: Chebyshev polynomial degree for spectrum forecasting.
spectrum_degree.zh: spectrum 预测的 Chebyshev 多项式阶数。

spectrum_history_size.zh: spectrum 预测历史最大行数。

spectrum_ridge_lambda.zh: spectrum 预测的 Ridge 正则化。

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=report peak (docs/reports)
size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=report peak (docs/reports)
